function.name: search_movie
function.description: Searches for basic information about movies, including the movie's name, director, actors, release date, and more.

movie_name.description: The name of the movie to search for.

genre.description: The genre of the movie to filter the search (optional).

release_date.description: The release date or range to filter the search results (optional).

function.name: view_showtimes
function.description: Fetches showtime information for a specific movie, including showtimes, locations, and available seating options.

movie_id.description: The unique identifier of the movie for which showtimes are being queried.

theater_location.description: The location of the theater to filter available showtimes (optional).

function.name: place_ticket
function.description: Submits a ticket purchase request, involving seat selection and payment details.

movie_id.description: The unique identifier of the movie to be watched.

showtime_id.description: The unique identifier of the selected showtime.

seats.description: The list of selected seats for the movie.

payment_method.description: The payment method selected for the ticket purchase (e.g., 'credit card', 'Alipay').

function.name: pay_ticket
function.description: Pays for the purchased movie ticket, handling sensitive payment and transaction details.

ticket_id.description: The unique identifier of the ticket to be paid for.

payment_method.description: The chosen payment method for the transaction (e.g., 'credit card', 'Alipay').

payment_amount.description: The total amount to be paid for the ticket.

function.name: refund_ticket
function.description: Requests a refund for a purchased ticket. This may involve personal and order information for processing the refund.

ticket_id.description: The unique identifier of the ticket to be refunded.

refund_reason.description: The reason for requesting the refund (optional).

function.name: post_comment
function.description: Posts a comment on a movie's information page, facilitating social interaction and sharing opinions.

movie_id.description: The unique identifier of the movie being commented on.

comment_text.description: The text content of the comment being posted.

function.name: view_viewing_history
function.description: Fetches the user's viewing history, revealing preferences and movie-watching habits.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose viewing history is being queried.

function.name: set_movie_reminder
function.description: Sets a reminder for an upcoming movie to alert the user about its screening time.

movie_id.description: The unique identifier of the movie for which a reminder is being set.

reminder_time.description: The time before the movie starts when the reminder should be triggered (e.g., '30 minutes').

function.name: view_user_comment_history
function.description: Views a user's comment history on the platform, which can reveal social behavior and commenting habits.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose comment history is being queried.
